exposure: early operative management of Vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) using a suprapubic approach (O'Conor et al.)
cohort: 70 patients with Vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) secondary to benign gynecological and obstetric surgeries, treated between August 2018 and October 2022.
finding: Early operative management of VVF secondary to benign gynecological and obstetric surgeries is feasible and effective, with a 90.1% success rate for fistula closure and significant improvement in patient symptoms.
mod_finding: Hysterectomy (including cesarean hysterectomy and simple hysterectomy) was the commonest cause of VVF (46.5%), followed by cesarean section (29.6%) and difficult labor (16.9%).
